D018-D001_h025.question: It’s hard to even describe what’s been happening. It's been about eight months now since… everything. Things just haven’t been the same since the accident. I notice it when I’m trying to sketch new designs; my mind just won't stay put, it wanders endlessly, something that never used to be a problem before that night. My ex-husband keeps telling me I'm unfocused and forgetful, which just makes me so angry and I end up yelling at him, cursing him out, then feeling even worse. I’m constantly on edge, and any sudden noise sends my heart racing, my palms sweating – it's like I'm right back there on the road. I also feel this deep shame, like it was all my fault, even though the police said it wasn't. And emotionally, I'm just… empty. I can't find joy in my work, or in anything really. It's like my emotions got cut off.
D018-D001_h025.options:
A. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    B. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)
    C. Posttraumatic Stress Disorder
    D. Acute Stress Disorder
